description_good_justification: The README opens with what the site is, a 2D map of the Milky Way's centre, nearby stars and the solar system moving in real time, and what it lets you do: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#about
interact_justification: The README links the live site and explains how to run it; the contributing guide explains how to ask questions, report bugs (GitHub issues) and contribute: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#i-have-a-question
contribution_justification: The contribution process (set up, tests, signed-off commits, pull requests and the required checks): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-code-contribution
contribution_requirements_justification: Requirements for contributions, including the commit style, tests with every change, the coverage floor, performance budgets and the DCO: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-code-contribution
documentation_basics_justification: The README describes the site, links it, and shows how to run, build and test it; the contributing guide describes every script, the tests, commits, pull requests and deploys: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#development
documentation_interface_justification: The site's interface is the map and its controls. The README lists what they do (pan, zoom, lock on a body, the layer toggles, hold, speed and reset), and every control is labelled on the page: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/README.md#about
sites_https_justification: The repository and the site are served over HTTPS; GitHub Pages enforces HTTPS for the site, and HTTP redirects to it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar and https://phun-ky.net/site-interstellar/
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL and open to anyone with a GitHub account: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/issues
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and reports and comments in English are accepted.
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained: more than 20 pull requests were merged and deployed in November 2026: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
repo_track_justification: Git records who changed what and when: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Every change is a public commit and pull request; there are no separate releases, main is what is deployed.
version_unique_justification: The site is continuously delivered: every merge to main is deployed, and each deployed version is identified by its git commit ID, which GitHub records for every GitHub Pages deployment: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/deployments
version_semver_justification: The site doesn't use version numbers: it is a single website, continuously delivered, so each deployed version is identified by its git commit instead. As the criterion's rationale notes, SemVer adds little for such a site.
version_tags_justification: Each deployed version is a commit on main, identified in git; GitHub records each GitHub Pages deployment against that commit: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/deployments
release_notes_justification: The site is a single website, not reused in multiple places, and is continuously delivered: every merge to main is deployed. Each change is described in its pull request: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
release_notes_vulns_justification: Everyone always runs the latest version: the site is a single website, continuously delivered, so there are no versions to choose between or update. A fixed vulnerability would be described in a GitHub security advisory.
report_responses_justification: No one outside the project has filed a bug report in the last 12 months, so none is unanswered. Reports are answered in their GitHub issue.
enhancement_responses_justification: No one outside the project has filed an enhancement request in the last 12 months, so none is unanswered. Requests are answered in their GitHub issue.
report_archive_justification: All issues and pull requests stay public and searchable on GitHub: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, which is enabled, or by email: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability has been reported in the last 6 months. Reports are acknowledged within 7 days: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#how-reports-are-handled
build_justification: npm run build builds the site with Vite into dist/, adding the Content Security Policy and the page metadata: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scripts
build_common_tools_justification: npm, Vite and the TypeScript compiler.
build_floss_tools_justification: npm, Node.js, Vite and TypeScript are all FLOSS.
test_justification: Unit tests with Node's test runner (npm test), Playwright tests of the built site in Google Chrome (npm run test:e2e), and performance budgets on a throttled phone (npm run test:performance): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
test_invocation_justification: npm test, the standard way to run tests in an npm project; npm run test:e2e and npm run test:performance for the checks of the built site.
test_most_justification: The unit tests cover 90% of lines, 92% of branches and 100% of functions, and npm run test:coverage fails below 89% of lines, 88% of branches or 95% of functions. The Playwright tests cover the map with mouse, keyboard and touch, on wide and narrow screens, and the 404 page: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The Check workflow lints, checks formatting, type-checks, runs the unit tests with coverage, builds and validates the HTML, and runs the end-to-end tests and performance budgets, on every pull request and, through the Deploy workflow, before every deploy from main: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
test_policy_justification: New code comes with its tests, and a fix with a test that fails without it: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes came with tests: touch pan and pinch zoom (#89) with unit and touch tests, the narrow screen layout (#88), the header (#87) and the page metadata (#84) with end-to-end tests, and the moons (#86) and asteroids (#81) fixes with tests that failed before them.
tests_documented_added_justification: The tests policy is part of the instructions for contributing code: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
warnings_justification: TypeScript in strict mode, ESLint (typescript-eslint, stylistic, Markdown and import rules) on every file, Markdown included, and html-validate on the built pages.
warnings_fixed_justification: Lint has no errors and no warnings, TypeScript has no errors, and the built HTML validates; CI fails on any of them.
warnings_strict_justification: TypeScript runs with strict: true, and CI runs ESLint with --max-warnings=0, so a warning fails the Check workflow.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer knows how to design secure software. The principles applied: no server, accounts or stored data; nothing read from the URL, storage or network; a Content Security Policy that allows only the site's own scripts, styles, images and fonts; nothing loaded from other hosts; least-privilege CI tokens, pinned Actions, and deploys only of commits that passed the checks. What the site guarantees and does not: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer knows the common errors for this kind of software: cross-site scripting (body facts are escaped before they are shown, and the Content Security Policy allows no inline scripts or styles), loading from other hosts (blocked by the policy and checked in the end-to-end tests), framing (a limit of a <meta> policy, documented), and the supply chain (locked dependencies installed with npm ci, a 14-day update cooldown, dependency review and pinned Actions): https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
crypto_published_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography: it is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript that draw a map of space in the browser, with no accounts, secrets or server. HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
crypto_call_justification: The site implements and calls no cryptography: it is static HTML, CSS and JavaScript that draw a map of space in the browser, with no accounts, secrets or server. HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations

crypto_random_justification: The site generates no keys, nonces or other security values. See the security expectations: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-expectations
delivery_mitm_justification: The site is served only over HTTPS by GitHub Pages, with HTTPS enforced, and deployed from GitHub Actions; the repository is served over HTTPS and SSH.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over HTTP; npm verifies the integrity hashes in package-lock.json against packages downloaded over HTTPS.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: The site's runtime dependencies have no known vulnerabilities (npm audit --omit=dev). The two open advisories are in development dependencies pulled in by ESLint, published less than 60 days ago, and are handled as the security policy describes: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependencies
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been found in the site or its runtime dependencies.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials are in the repository, and the workflows use no repository secrets; GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#secrets
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (GitHub default setup) analyses every pull request and push to main, for the TypeScript code and the workflows, and ESLint runs on every pull request.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL analyses the JavaScript and TypeScript code and the GitHub Actions workflows on every push to main and every pull request, and the ruleset on main blocks merging while it reports an error or a high or critical security alert: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/SECURITY.md#code-scanning
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL has no open alerts; the ruleset blocks merging with a high or critical one.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every pull request and every push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: An automated test suite with more than 80% branch coverage (92%) runs on every pull request and before every deploy, and the Playwright tests run the built site in Chrome with varied input: mouse, wheel, keyboard and touch, phone, tablet and wide viewports, device pixel ratios, axe accessibility checks and a throttled network and CPU: https://github.com/phun-ky/site-interstellar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#tests
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: All software is TypeScript on JavaScript runtimes, which are memory-safe; there is no C, C++ or other memory-unsafe code.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The tests assert on every result, and the end-to-end tests fail on any console error, uncaught exception, failed request or Content Security Policy violation in the page; the build throws when the policy cannot be added correctly.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No medium or higher severity vulnerability has been found by the tests.
